name: Kayto Shields
source: Captain in the Cera Space Force. Commander of the Sunrider. Has a younger sister living on Cera, whom he keeps a picture of in his office, who is MIA. Conducting his own war on PACT and is the highest ranking officer from Cera that isn't either dead or surrendered with the rest of Cera.
translation: Captain in the Cera Space Force. Commander of the Sunrider. Has a younger sister living on Cera, whom he keeps a picture of in his office, who is MIA. Conducting his own war on PACT and is the highest ranking officer from Cera that isn't either dead or surrendered with the rest of Cera.
